extDescription.message: Clear Chrome history and selected browsing data on exit, with automatic retry on the next startup.

faqAccountHistoryA.message: No. It clears local Chrome history. History stored by Google is managed separately in Web & App Activity.

faqAccountHistoryQ.message: Does it delete Google Account search history?

faqCookieA.message: Cookie cleanup is off by default. When enabled, it signs you out of many websites. Add sites you want to preserve to Keep login first.

faqCookieQ.message: What happens if cookies are cleared?

faqGoogleA.message: Yes, unless Google is in Keep login. It clears the Google web session and may pause Chrome Sync, but does not remove the account from your Chrome profile.

faqGoogleQ.message: Does cookie cleanup sign me out of Google?

faqMacA.message: Normally cleanup runs when the last window closes. If Chrome quits or is force-quit before it finishes, cleanup completes immediately on the next startup.

faqMacQ.message: Does closing a window on macOS trigger cleanup?
